title: PersonaFrontmatter
description: Schema for z-harness persona file YAML frontmatter. Persona files are markdown with a YAML front block between '---' delimiters; the body after the closing '---' is the prompt prefix.

name.description: Kebab-case persona identifier. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ — starts with a lowercase letter, contains only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, no trailing hyphen.

description.description: One-line human-readable description of the persona.

compatible_roles.description: Optional list of role names this persona is designed for. Absence is valid. Mismatch at bind time emits a persona_compat_warning event (soft; does not block).

contract.description: Optional output contract hint. When the bound role declares an expected_contract, this must match or binding fails.
